title: Tigrayan Zigni
community: Tigray and Eritrea — the red meat wat of the north
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Tigrayan Zigni — the northern highland meat wat made with beef or lamb in a Tigrinya-style berbere sauce. Zigni is the Tigrinya word for the red meat wat — analogous to Key Wat but with korerima and a more northerly spice profile shared with Eritrea.
longDesc: Zigni is the prestige Tigrayan meat dish — the celebration food of the ancient northern highland culture, made with the korerima and specific spice ratios that define Tigrinya cooking.
steps: Add kibbeh and berbere. Fry 4 minutes.
chefTips: Zigni is always served with taita (thicker injera of Tigray).
commonMistakes: Standard berbere instead of Tigrinya proportion.
cookingScience: See ETH021 for meat wat science.
culturalNote: Zigni is the food of Tigrinya identity — shared between Ethiopia's Tigray region and Eritrea, it represents the ancient highland culture of the northern mountains.
